request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the yellow skin of his head, ears, shoulders, chest and hand becomes a mid-tone olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows; not yellow, and the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the brown leather cap and crossed straps, the eye, teeth and tongue, the dagger, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
